triage.summary: Tom Becker at QuickFit Gyms reports that the website chatbot has shown “Something went wrong” for every message since this morning. A promotion is running today and customers are complaining on Instagram; he asks Alex to investigate ASAP.

task.title: Investigate the QuickFit chatbot outage

Best,
Alex
